qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Permitted quarry and kiln network creates strong local logistics moats, but bulk cement cyclicality, capital intensity, and lack of real pricing power limit returns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Permitted quarry and kiln networks provide local logistics protection, but bulk cement cyclicality and heavy capital intensity hold 10-year ROIC to 5-11% (median 8.6%), failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year reported ROIC across 2015-2024 ranged between 5.2% and 11.1%, with a 10-year median of ~7.4% (and 4-year median of 8.59%), consistently below the 12% hurdle. Bulk cement economics lack through-cycle pricing power above energy and structural carbon costs. The spin-off of high-margin North American assets (Amrize) leaves the remaining entity heavily exposed to European ETS decarbonization capex.
